title: Agnès Varda's birth chart
metaDescription: Agnès Varda's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 8.8° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Five of the eight placements whose signs are settled fall in fire signs — at least half of what the unknown hour leaves certain. A fire emphasis is read as appetite for the first move, with information gathered by doing rather than before doing.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 8.8° Gemini. That falls in the first decan, 0°–10°, sub-ruled by Mercury in the classical scheme — an air sign read through a mutable season.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 1.8° Cancer, Mars was at 10.2° Aries. Read together: a mind that absorbs before it argues; drive that ignites on contact.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The Sun and Mars hold the closest angle here — a sextile, 1.4° wide. The scheme reads a sextile as a door left unlocked. Useful, and entirely dependent on someone walking through it. Behind it, the Sun sextile Uranus at 2.1°, and Jupiter trine Neptune at 2.5° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These angles were checked through every hour of that civil day and survive throughout, which is why an unrecorded hour does not disturb them.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: One planet here sits in a sign the classical scheme scores. Mars in Aries at 10.2° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. The old table grades terrain, not talent — a placement in fall works uphill, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 8 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 5 fire, 2 water, 1 air; by modality, 5 cardinal, 2 mutable, 1 fixed. Fire weights a chart toward initiative — starting, asserting, spending energy to find out what happens. Venus crossed from Taurus into Gemini during that day, so its sign is left open. No settled placement falls in earth — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Saturn was retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Libra into Scorpio during that day at the birthplace, travelling 11.9° between one midnight and the next. Half the day belongs to each sign, and the split falls at an unrecorded hour — so this page holds the Moon as a genuine unknown.
